message: Choose which mana to produce from Flooded Grove (tapping to pay for a spell)
annotation_description: Grok4F Undrdog used An Offer You Can't Refuse to counter DSV3 Grudge's Evolution Charm, which is a very low-value spell (likely just fetching a basic land or returning a creature). An Offer You Can't Refuse gives the opponent two Treasure tokens, which is a significant cost. Trading a counterspell plus giving two Treasures to stop a 2-mana charm is a terrible rate of exchange. The counterspell should be saved for a much more impactful threat. Additionally, Grok4F had to tap Flooded Grove (using the {G/U} + {T} ability to make {U}{U}), spending a green mana from pool plus the land tap just to counter a minor spell.

Loran of the Third Path has no artifacts or enchantments on any opponent's battlefield to destroy, wasting its powerful ETB trigger. Meanwhile, Selvala would provide significant mana ramp to deploy the expensive hand (Forgotten Ancient at 4, Mangara at 4, Body of Knowledge at 5, Fisher's Talent at 3+).

message: Select a player, planeswalker, or battle to attack
annotation_description: Attacking Qwen3 Libby who has Elephant Token (3/3) and Ravenous Rotbelly (4/5) as blockers, limiting damage output. Llama4 Humble has only Rashmi (2/3) as a blocker, meaning almost all damage would get through for potentially 15+ damage instead of ~5.

message: Select a player, planeswalker, or battle to attack
annotation_description: DSV3 Grudge attacked Qwen3 Libby who has two blockers (3/3 Elephant Token and 4/5 Ravenous Rotbelly) and 30 HP, instead of attacking Llama4 Humble who has 28 HP and ZERO creatures to block. Attacking Llama4 would deal approximately 25 unblocked damage (9+5+~11), leaving them at 3 HP and nearly eliminating them from the game.
